metadata.question: Did temperatures exceed 100 degrees fahrenheit in Prescott, Arizona during the month of June in 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Prescott, Arizona (need to define a Point geometry) - Time: June 2017 (2017-06-01 to 2017-06-30) - Collection: MODIS Land Surface Temperature (MOD11A1 or MYD11A1) or ERA5-Land temperature data - MOD11A1.006 provides daily LST at ~1km resolution, which is suitable 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for this question - we want to know if temperatures exceeded 100°F - MODIS LST has QC bands we should check for valid data - Need to convert Kelvin to Fahrenheit: F = (K - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid result: Temperature values in reasonable range (e.g., 20°C to 50°C or 68°F to 122°F for Arizona summer) - C1: No images in collection - C2: No valid pixels after QC filtering - C3: Result is None/NaN or unreasonable (e.g., <-50°F or >150°F) - A: If max temperature >= 100°F - B: If max temperature < 100°F ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define location and time const prescott = ee.Geometry.Point([-112.4685, 34.5400]); // Prescott, Arizona const startDate = '2017-06-01'; const endDate = '2017-06-30'; console.log('Analyzing temperatures in Prescott, Arizona for June 2017...'); // 2. Load MODIS LST data (Terra satellite) let collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') .filterBounds(prescott) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'LST_Night_1km']); const collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No MODIS data found. Trying Aqua satellite...'); collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD11A1') .filterBounds(prescott) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'LST_Night_1km']); const aquaSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Aqua images found: ${aquaSize}`); if (aquaSize === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Convert Kelvin to Fahrenheit and find maximum temperature const lstToFahrenheit = function(img) { const dayF = img.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15).multiply(9/5).add(32); const nightF = img.select('LST_Night_1km').multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15).multiply(9/5).add(32); return img.addBands(dayF.rename('Day_F')).addBands(nightF.rename('Night_F')); }; const collectionF = collection.map(lstToFahrenheit); // 4. Get statistics const stats = collectionF.select(['Day_F', 'Night_F']).reduce(ee.Reducer.max()) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: prescott, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const maxDayTemp = stats['Day_F_max']; const maxNightTemp = stats['Night_F_max']; console.log(`Max Day Temperature: ${maxDayTemp ? maxDayTemp.toFixed(1) : 'null'}°F`); console.log(`Max Night Temperature: ${maxNightTemp ? maxNightTemp.toFixed(1) : 'null'}°F`); // 5. Validation and answer if (maxDayTemp === null || maxDayTemp === undefined) { console.log('C3'); return; } if (maxDayTemp < -50 || maxDayTemp > 150) { console.log('Temperature out of valid range'); console.log('C3'); return; } const maxTemp = Math.max(maxDayTemp, maxNightTemp || 0); console.log(`Overall Max Temperature: ${maxTemp.toFixed(1)}°F`); if (maxTemp >= 100) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
